Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma

 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  19.07.2023 ABA No. 555 of 2023  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Present Application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory of 2023, registered at police station Laksar, District Haridwar under Sections 323, 504, 506, 498A, 376 read with Section 511 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Applicant no. 1- accused Mohd. Parvez Ahmed is the husband of the informant and applicant no.
2-accused Smt. Jubeda is the mother-in-law of the informant.
3. Heard Mr. Bilal Ahmed, learned counsel for the applicants and Mrs. Manisha Rana Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State 4.
Learned counsel for the State has sought four weeks' time to file objection to the Anticipatory Bail Application.

5. List on 15.09.2023 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.
6.
Mr. Bilal Ahmed, Advocate, contended that the allegation of attempt to rape is against the brother-in-law (Jeth) of the informant.
There may be a chance of amicable settlement between the applicants and the informant.
Steps to be taken within four days.

9. Having considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion as to the merit of the case, this Court directs that in the event of arrest, present applicants-accused Mohd. Parvez Ahmed and Smt. Jubeda shall be released on Interim Anticipatory Bail on furnishing their personal bond of Rs. 30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating ABA/555/2023 on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20267511/
1 Officer/Arresting Officer.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 19.07.2023 Shiksha ABA/555/2023 on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20267511/
